description: Snapshot after Phase 3-4-8 architectural changes: deterministic intent fast path + strict profile default + persistent httpx.Client + ChatClient metrics_sink. Measured on the same 4-case probe as baseline.
note: Persistent httpx saves ~5-15ms per chat call on localhost (negligible at this scale); the 2.53x is from the prompt contract + profile + evidence shrink work, not from httpx alone.
